summary: On June 18, 2026, COSCIENS Biopharma Inc. (TSX:CSCI, OTCQB:CSCIF) filed a Form 6-K reporting its annual general meeting held June 17, 2026. At the meeting, shareholders approved the re-election of directors, re-appointment of Deloitte LLP as auditors, and a share capital amendment comprising a 1:150 consolidation followed by a 50:1 split. The filing also announced the appointment of Chairman Peter H. Puccetti, who had served as Interim CEO since November, as permanent President and CEO effective immediately. No deal terms were disclosed. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for further details on the share capital amendment timeline and execution.
